failure_policy: No automatic retries; preserve reservations and partial evidence; dependent stages stop
promotion: Retain original parent; experimental learned teacher is not promoted
final_test: No final-test decoding, generation, training, selection or scoring
recovery: Reuse category-corrected independently replayed reference evidence; no reference re-execution
image_fix: No image-level runtime volume environment; set caches only inside worker after volume mount. Mandatory CPU probe on identical image/volume before GPU baseline.
